notes: The Map is in 3D. China is a small model with its real relief: the Tibetan plateau and its snowy ranges high in the west, the basins and plains low, forests as crowds of little trees, deserts, the two great rivers and the Great Wall. Twist two fingers to turn it, slide two fingers up or down to tilt it, pinch to zoom; the compass faces north again. You can no longer pull back far or drag the country off the screen. The city you are building in has a hovering red marker with Shi Shi in it; levels you have not reached are not on the map at all, and no city names are shown on it. Along the bottom sit your progress on the current monument and one big button: Continue building, or Build now
